يتبارك (form VI)
# يَتَبَارَكُ (yatabāraku) /ja.ta.baː.ra.ku/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَبَارَكَ (tabāraka)
# يَتَبَارَكَ (yatabāraka) /ja.ta.baː.ra.ka/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَارَكَ (tabāraka)
# يَتَبَارَكْ (yatabārak) /ja.ta.baː.rak/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَبَارَكَ (tabāraka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
